purpose: Complete controlled physical event/readback checks and measure same-configuration repeatability; no method-performance acceptance.

repetitions.budget_mode: original common_budget k=1.0, not W-selected budgets
repetitions.configuration_changes: none; extra passive collider geometry readback must be isolated and versioned without changing stepping, reset, actions or event semantics
required_reports: all 12 baseline-plus-new results, 2 runs per configuration, attempts/missing/failed denominators retained
terminal labels, all event flags and safety_y, goal distance, active duration, internal model J and actual mechanical work J
per-configuration paired duration/work/goal-distance differences and maximum/RMS position differences on the common active time interval; no alignment after the initial alignment
actual clocks, applied/observed commands, clean parameters, collider local/world transforms, shape dimensions, collision-enabled state and cloned environment origins
descriptive differences only; two runs do not establish general reliability or bitwise deterministic physics

controlled_cases.fixture_scope: isolated synthetic fixtures only; original benchmark maps, selected models and frozen v2 resources stay unchanged

cases_in_order.name: intermediate collision then raw-pose exit
cases_in_order.required_observation: Actual root readbacks cross a raw obstacle in an inner 200Hz substep of a 50Hz interval, then exit; a second active environment allows remaining substeps to execute.
cases_in_order.assertion: The first collision latches at its actual tick; terminal state/time/model budget/work freeze for that episode while later raw poses and the companion episode are separately retained.

cases_in_order.name: inflated danger entry and exit without raw collision
cases_in_order.required_observation: Actual root readbacks enter and exit the frozen footprint-plus-delta danger set while avoiding the raw collision set.
cases_in_order.assertion: danger becomes true and irreversible safety_y remains positive after exit; danger alone does not invent a terminal collision.

cases_in_order.name: turning footprint sweep
cases_in_order.required_observation: Actual position/yaw readbacks create an oriented frozen-footprint corner sweep intersecting a raw obstacle, with a nonintersecting center chord.
cases_in_order.assertion: The production geometry/event path detects the sweep; requested poses alone are not evidence.

cases_in_order.name: simultaneous goal and collision
cases_in_order.required_observation: An isolated synthetic target and raw collider produce both flags on the same actual readback tick.
cases_in_order.assertion: Both flags are saved and the existing production LABELS priority wins; the case is not counted as a navigation success.

cases_in_order.name: asynchronous batch termination and active masking
cases_in_order.required_observation: Two actual environments at distinct measured clone origins terminate at different inner substeps, including an incomplete low-level interval.
cases_in_order.assertion: No cross-environment coordinate leakage; each event step is charged once, later inactive steps are excluded, and the still-active episode continues with actual clock and command evidence.

cases_in_order.name: native physical contact and collider geometry
cases_in_order.required_observation: A separately marked contact fixture uses the actual unchanged robot and an enabled cuboid; save measured world/local transforms, composed shape dimensions and native obstacle-contact evidence over stepped physics.
cases_in_order.assertion: Robot-obstacle pair-specific contact evidence is present; ground support forces or pose writes cannot substitute. Record physical response separately from pose-injected event cases.

controlled_cases.pose_injection_disclosure: C01-C05 may deliberately write fixture root poses between physical ticks, always logging requested and actual states separately; these validate readback/event/accounting, not natural locomotion or collision response. C06 must obtain native contact evidence independently.
controlled_cases.numeric_audit: Reuse existing trace-audit tolerances where applicable; declare any additional readback/round-trip numeric tolerances and exact fixture schedules in the sealed harness before its first simulation.
controlled_cases.failure_policy: A missing required actual event/contact, assertion failure or invalid readback is NOT a pass; save evidence and stop, without changing the fixture or retrying within this authorization.

before_first_simulation: Implement isolated controlled runner and repetition binding; preserve all sealed baseline sources and old outputs.
Main agent performs tailored basic tests, including missing-approval refusal; no subagents or real simulation for preparation.
Freeze exact fixture maps/targets/schedules, numeric audit tolerances, source hashes, attempt slots, resource ledger and command before running; no adaptive case design after observing new outputs.
An explicit confirmation may authorize implementing and executing this bounded package; changes to meaning, quotas, controller, data use or framework still require separate resolution.
Create a separate APPROVED registration and hash only after user confirmation; PROPOSED is never accepted by an executable entry.

stop_conditions: Any protected identity, host, dependency, GPU availability, actual clean configuration or coordinate evidence fails.
An entry/runtime/trace assertion fails, actual controlled evidence is absent, or physical and business failures cannot be distinguished.
The cumulative 4-hour GPU wall-clock allocation, 9 application starts, episode/case/time/tick cap or claimed slot would be exceeded.
No automatic retries, replacing failed attempts, extending measurement windows, reallocating unused slots, or changing scores to pass.

acceptance_disposition.NAV_067_may_be_true_only_after: All original six acceptance criteria have actual evidence, every controlled case passes, repeatability denominators/deviations are reported, and the main agent completes local plus end-to-end consistency review. No automatic PASS based on this protocol or script exit.
acceptance_disposition.repetition_performance_failures: Timeout, over-budget or other business outcomes are retained and do not become event-wiring failures by themselves. Unexplained implementation/configuration differences stop sign-off.
acceptance_disposition.performance_gate: No new physical success threshold here; NAV-043 remains separate, false and unexecuted. Prior G4/efficiency FAIL and accepted limitations are retained.
